meta.name: AEGIS-PHARMA V2 Architecture Explorer
meta.description: Interactive map of the actual implemented AEGIS-PHARMA V2 system: a FastAPI orchestrator wrapping six governed LangGraph workflows sharing one 14-node spine, a Next.js/React operator UI, SQLite audit + user stores, Neo4j evidence corpus, Redis response cache, and the eval-ai-cache harness.
meta.note: Reflects the actual implemented V2 codebase as read from services/api, services/integration, packages/, security/, infra/, apps/web, and eval-ai-cache -- not the Stage 08 design-only view this file replaces. Every node's file path and every edge was verified against real source during this analysis.

nodes.label: Overview
nodes.description: The ten-second read: pending queue count, dashboard terminal-state distribution, dependency health, and 8 most-recent runs. Polls /api/dashboard, /api/queue, /api/health/detail, /api/runs.

nodes.label: Decision Queue
nodes.description: Primary operational page: every run currently paused awaiting a human decision, filterable client-side by workflow/search/sort. Reads /api/queue.

nodes.label: Decision Detail
nodes.description: One pending decision opened from the queue; wraps RunDetailView with back-link to the queue.

nodes.label: Run History
nodes.description: Server-side filtered/paginated history over the append-only audit store. Reads /api/runs and /api/runs/filters.

nodes.label: Run Detail (history)
nodes.description: A historical (possibly already-decided) run opened from Run History; wraps RunDetailView.

nodes.label: Evidence Explorer
nodes.description: Read-only browse of the full evidence corpus including non-citable items, so a reviewer can check 'can I rely on this?'. Reads /api/evidence and /api/evidence/stats.

nodes.label: Governance Center
nodes.description: Displays the controls actually enforced elsewhere (prohibitions, approver roles, evidence authority, HITL tiers) as a read model. Reads /api/governance.

nodes.label: System Health
nodes.description: Measured dependency status (Redis, Neo4j, audit store, LLM config) from actual probes. Reads /api/health/detail.

nodes.label: Workflows / Submit Run
nodes.description: Form to submit a new governed run against one of the 6 workflows and a fixture subject id; posts to /api/runs (submitRun).

nodes.label: Evaluation & Security Coverage
nodes.description: Two tabs: live eval-ai-cache scorecard (/api/evals/scorecard) and curated 84-inject V1->V2 coverage ledger (/api/coverage/injects).

nodes.label: AppShell / Nav
nodes.description: Persistent sidebar navigation across all 8 pages, with a live pending-queue badge from /api/queue.

nodes.label: AuthContext (authenticated)
nodes.description: Stage 22: replaced the old unauthenticated OperatorContext. Wraps lib/auth/session.ts via useSyncExternalStore and exposes signIn/signOut, backed by real POST /api/auth/login and /api/auth/logout calls.

nodes.label: OperatorBar
nodes.description: Sidebar-footer control showing the authenticated user (display name, role, session expiry) and a Sign out action, sourced entirely from AuthContext -- no free-text identity entry remains.

nodes.label: auth session store
nodes.description: Stage 22 localStorage-backed session store for the real bearer-token login. Read directly by lib/api/client.ts (both read() and mutate()) to attach the Authorization header on every request, and by AuthContext/RequireAuth to gate every route except /login.

nodes.label: API client (read/mutate)
nodes.description: The single HTTP boundary to the Orchestrator API. Both read() (retries idempotent GETs) and mutate() (submitRun/decideRun, sent exactly once, never retried) attach the bearer token from session.ts; a 401 response clears the local session so the app re-prompts for login.

nodes.label: ApprovalPanel
nodes.description: The human action panel: approve/reject/veto/dual-approval-leg controls, mandatory >=12-char justification, and the automation-bias 'exceptions acknowledged' checkbox. Calls decideRun -> POST /api/runs/{run_id}/decide.

nodes.label: RunDetailView
nodes.description: Shared two-column workspace (investigation + action) used by both the live Decision Detail and historical Run Detail pages. Reads /api/runs/{run_id}.

nodes.label: DecisionSupport tab
nodes.description: Renders the draft summary/claims and cited evidence for a pending run's decision-support package.

nodes.label: DomainFindings tab
nodes.description: Renders the workflow-specific structured payload (BatchPayload/PVPayload/SupplyPayload/etc.) for a pending run.

nodes.label: GovernanceChecks tab
nodes.description: Shows which guard/critic/policy checks a run passed and the approver roles/legs required.

nodes.label: AuditTimeline
nodes.description: Renders the merged, ordered audit event list (AgentRun, HumanOverrideRecorded, HitlEscalation, HitlExpired, ProhibitedActionBlocked) for one run.

nodes.label: EvidenceCard
nodes.description: Renders one evidence catalog item with its citable/authority/supersedes badges.

nodes.label: StatusBar / InjectRow
nodes.description: Coverage-status pill and per-inject row renderers for the Evaluation & Security Coverage page.

nodes.label: POST /api/auth/login
nodes.description: Verifies user_id/password against user_store (PBKDF2-HMAC), issues a server-side session row + bearer token.

nodes.label: POST /api/auth/logout
nodes.description: Deletes the caller's session row. Requires a valid bearer token via require_user.

nodes.label: GET /api/auth/me
nodes.description: Returns the caller's own resolved session info. Requires require_user.

nodes.label: GET /api/auth/roles
nodes.description: Public: the role/boundary catalog (product_use, must_never) so the frontend can render it without a second hardcoded copy.

nodes.label: POST /api/runs
nodes.description: Builds/fetches the cached (workflow, subject_id) graph, invokes it with a fresh GovernedState, and registers a pending queue entry if it interrupts. Requires require_user.

nodes.label: GET /api/queue
nodes.description: Lists all pending (interrupted) runs from the in-memory pending_queue registry.

nodes.label: POST /api/runs/{run_id}/decide
nodes.description: Resumes a paused run with a human decision (Command(resume=...)). Enforces shape + Stage 22 authorization (user_store.approver_string_for/can_veto) before the request reaches the graph. Never retried.

nodes.label: GET /api/runs
nodes.description: Filtered/paginated page of historical runs from the append-only audit store.

nodes.label: GET /api/runs/filters
nodes.description: Distinct column values actually present in the audit store, for the History page's filter dropdowns.

nodes.label: GET /api/runs/{run_id}
nodes.description: One run merged from two sources: the in-memory pending registry (if still paused in this process) and the audit store (once finalized).

nodes.label: GET /api/evidence
nodes.description: Full evidence catalog including non-citable items, each labelled with whether it may be relied upon.

nodes.label: GET /api/evidence/stats
nodes.description: Evidence corpus counts by status/citability, from Neo4j.

nodes.label: GET /api/governance
nodes.description: Governance Center snapshot, assembled by governance_view.py from live enforcement artefacts.

nodes.label: GET /api/evals/scorecard
nodes.description: Runs the real eval-ai-cache grading harness in-process, live, on every request (~25ms, no LLM/network calls).

nodes.label: GET /api/coverage/injects
nodes.description: Serves the curated, versioned V1-inject-to-V2-reality coverage mapping file, read-only.

nodes.label: GET /api/dashboard
nodes.description: Cost/guardrail-trip/terminal-state/cache-hit panels computed from the audit store and Redis counters.

nodes.label: GET /api/health
nodes.description: Trivial liveness check + list of the 6 workflow names the API serves.

nodes.label: GET /api/health/detail
nodes.description: Measured dependency health for every dependency (Redis, Neo4j, audit store, LLM config) plus current pending-queue depth.

nodes.label: require_user dependency
nodes.description: FastAPI dependency resolving a Bearer token to a live user_store.Session, or raising 401. Establishes identity only -- does not itself decide permission.

nodes.label: user_store (SQLite)
nodes.description: 11 synthetic role-backed accounts, PBKDF2-HMAC password hashes, server-side session rows with 8h expiry. Same SQLite file as audit_store. Holds ROLE_CATALOG mapping login roles to each graph's PRIMARY_APPROVER strings, and approver_string_for()/can_veto() used by decide_run's authorization check.

nodes.label: seed_users script
nodes.description: One-off script that creates the 10 ROLE_CATALOG accounts in user_store via create_user().

nodes.label: intake
nodes.description: Node 1 of the shared 14-node spine, present identically in all 6 workflow graphs. Runs DenialOfWalletGuard.check_and_admit before anything else; refuses (no tokens spent) if the daily run/spend ceiling is exceeded.

nodes.label: policy_load
nodes.description: Loads the versioned prohibition contract for this workflow. Fail-closed: PolicyEngineUnavailable -> terminal_state=refused, no cached-policy fallback (ADR-005).

nodes.label: retrieve
nodes.description: Calls evidence.retrieve (Neo4j-backed, server-filtered to approved/draft only). One scope-preserving broadening permitted (G3) before the evidence gate abstains.

nodes.label: evidence_gate
nodes.description: Second independent check over the retrieved evidence list as a whole (ADR-003). Routes to the domain tool if sufficient, back to retrieve once to broaden, or abstains/defect-halts.

nodes.label: domain tool (workflow-specific)
nodes.description: The one node that differs in NAME per workflow: reconcile (batch_review/research_review), duplicate_check+normalize_terminology (pv_intake, hard-ordered before synthesize), generate_options (supply_planning), integrity_check (clinical_integrity), completeness_check (regulatory_completeness). Always deterministic, no LLM.

nodes.label: synthesize
nodes.description: First LLM call: drafts a DecisionSupportOutput (summary + cited claims). Checks response_cache first (batch_review/research_review only). ADR-007: any exception -> abstained/degraded_mode, never a guess.

nodes.label: guard1 (prohibited_action_guard)
nodes.description: First of two runtime-guard passes over the freshly-generated draft text. Blocked verdict routes straight to finalize as terminal_state=blocked.

nodes.label: critic_verify
nodes.description: Second LLM call: an independent Critic model verifies the draft. approve_for_human -> guard2; a reject reason code routes to retry-synthesize, hitl_escalate, or blocked_terminal depending on the code and MAX_LLM_CALLS=6 (G1).

nodes.label: guard2 (prohibited_action_guard, +cache write)
nodes.description: Second guard pass, over whatever the Critic approved. The ONLY point that writes a cleared draft into response_cache (batch_review/research_review only).

nodes.label: hitl_route
nodes.description: Sets the required approver_roles (single role for 4 workflows, two-role dual-approval for supply_planning) and hitl_status=pending.

nodes.label: hitl_interrupt
nodes.description: Calls LangGraph interrupt(), pausing the graph until services/api decide_run resumes it with Command(resume=...). Writes HumanOverrideRecorded / HitlExpired to the audit store. supply_planning loops here until both legs land; pv_intake's veto short-circuits here to rejected.

nodes.label: blocked_terminal
nodes.description: Marks terminal_state=blocked for the PROHIBITION_ADJACENT critic route, which bypasses guard2 entirely and is never retried.

nodes.label: abstain_cap
nodes.description: Marks terminal_state=abstained/cap_exceeded when MAX_LLM_CALLS (6) is hit -- alerted as an engineering defect (SEV-3), never silently retried further.

nodes.label: finalize
nodes.description: The mandatory last node on every path. Records real token usage into DenialOfWalletGuard, then writes the AgentRun record to audit_store -- a response cannot reach the caller without this write (ADR-006).

nodes.label: batch_review graph
nodes.description: build_graph(). Domain tool: batch.reconcile. Approver: EU Qualified Person. Has response_cache read/write. Stable since Stage 10/20a.

nodes.label: pv_intake graph
nodes.description: build_pv_graph(). Domain tools: pv.duplicate_check -> pv.normalize_terminology (hard order). Approver: Global Head of Pharmacovigilance. Unique: Patient Safety Representative's advisory veto, 100% escalation (no cache).

nodes.label: supply_planning graph
nodes.description: build_supply_graph(). Domain tool: supply.generate_options. Dual approval: Supply Chain VP (planning leg) + EU Qualified Person (quality leg) -- both required, replay-safe via audit_store.has_recorded_action.

nodes.label: research_review graph
nodes.description: build_research_graph(). Domain tool: research.reconcile. Approver: Head of Preclinical Research. Has response_cache read/write (Stage 21).

nodes.label: clinical_integrity graph
nodes.description: build_clinical_graph(). Domain tool: clinical.integrity_check. Approver: Clinical Trial Medical Monitor.

nodes.label: regulatory_completeness graph
nodes.description: build_regulatory_graph(). Domain tool: regulatory.completeness_check. Approver: Head of Regulatory Affairs.

nodes.label: evidence.retrieve
nodes.description: Neo4j-backed. Server-side filters untrusted/superseded items out INSIDE the Cypher query (ADR-003, BC-2) -- no code path returns them to a run. Enforces the single-broadening ceiling (G3) via a per-run counter.

nodes.label: evidence_gate.check
nodes.description: Second independent ADR-003 check over the retrieved list as a whole. Structurally defends against an empty/wrong-status list being mistaken for sufficient.

nodes.label: batch.reconcile
nodes.description: Deterministic reconciliation over synthetic batch fixtures (tests/fixtures/synthetic/batches/*.json). Rejects any evidence_id not returned by this run's own retrieval call.

nodes.label: pv.duplicate_check
nodes.description: Deterministic duplicate-candidate check over synthetic PV case fixtures. Must complete before synthesize (DDD hard ordering), enforced as a graph edge, not by this tool.

nodes.label: pv.normalize_terminology
nodes.description: MedDRA-style terminology normalization suggestions. `applied` is fixed False by the schema -- a caller cannot construct a response claiming the suggestion was applied.

nodes.label: supply.generate_options
nodes.description: Deterministic shortage-option generation over synthetic supply fixtures. Constraint filtering happens before the tool returns; the agent ranks, never widens, the result set.

nodes.label: research.reconcile
nodes.description: Deterministic reconciliation over synthetic research fixtures. Same pattern as batch.reconcile (Stage 21).

nodes.label: clinical.integrity_check
nodes.description: Deterministic integrity check over synthetic clinical fixtures (Stage 21).

nodes.label: regulatory.completeness_check
nodes.description: Deterministic completeness check over synthetic regulatory fixtures (Stage 21).

nodes.label: prohibited_action_guard.check
nodes.description: ADR-004 layer-3 runtime guard: pattern-matches generated draft text against the workflow's banned_terms/banned_field_names. One implementation, called twice per run (guard1, guard2) -- never asks the model to judge its own output.

nodes.label: policy_engine
nodes.description: Loads security/policies/policy_contract.v1.json and returns a workflow's ProhibitionContract. Raises PolicyEngineUnavailable (fail-closed, no fallback) if unreadable or version-mismatched.

nodes.label: response_cache
nodes.description: Redis-backed. Only ever caches a guard-and-Critic-CLEARED draft (never raw/blocked). Key includes subject_id (fixed a real cross-subject collision bug) but never policy_contract_version. Re-validates every cached evidence_id's CURRENT status in Neo4j on read -- a since-superseded entry is a miss, not a stale hit.

nodes.label: hitl_route (4-tier ladder)
nodes.description: Batch-review-specific escalation ladder module (T0->T1 reminder 8h->T2 escalation 16h widens to Chief Quality Officer->T3 expiry 24h = timed_out). Timeout is always no-action, never auto-approve.

nodes.label: hitl_decision.decode
nodes.description: Shared across all 6 graphs (unlike the graph modules themselves): decodes an interrupt() resume payload into a structured HitlDecision(action, justification, claimed_identity, leg), with legacy bare-string backward compatibility.

nodes.label: DenialOfWalletGuard
nodes.description: Hard per-(user, workflow, day) ceiling: 20 runs/day, $45/day at worst-case token estimate. Checked at intake (check_and_admit) and updated with real usage at finalize (record_run). A ceiling, not a tuned budget.

nodes.label: evidence_catalog
nodes.description: Read-only Neo4j query layer for the Evidence Explorer ONLY -- structurally separate from evidence_retrieve (returns EvidenceCatalogItem, not the domain EvidenceItem type; nothing in any graph imports this module). Deliberately shows non-citable/superseded items.

nodes.label: tool_manifest.verify_manifest
nodes.description: SHA-256 integrity check over every tool_contracts/*.schema.json against tool_manifest.json, detecting a tampered or newly-registered write-capable tool contract (INJ-066). Run at process startup / CI, not per-request.

nodes.label: audit_store (SQLite, append-only)
nodes.description: evidence/audit_store.sqlite3. Tables: agent_run, human_override_recorded, hitl_escalation, hitl_expired, prohibited_action_blocked. No UPDATE/DELETE exists anywhere in this module -- WORM emulated by the absence of any mutating function, not by a comment.

nodes.label: pending_queue (in-memory)
nodes.description: Module-level dict of currently-paused runs' decision-support packages. Single-process, does not survive a restart -- explicitly NOT the audit trail.

nodes.label: policy_contract.v1.json
nodes.description: Versioned prohibition contracts (banned_terms/banned_field_names) for all 6 workflows. The one file every guard and policy_load node ultimately reads.

nodes.label: Knowledge graph (Neo4j)
nodes.description: The evidence corpus: EvidenceItem nodes with status/authority/jurisdiction/supersedes edges. Backs evidence.retrieve (governed, filtered) and evidence_catalog (unfiltered, read-only) identically but through separate query paths.

nodes.label: Redis (response cache)
nodes.description: Backs response_cache's cleared-draft cache and hit/miss counters. Unconfigured/unreachable is a documented ADR-007 bypass (ok, degraded_mode 'not_configured'), never a hard run failure.

nodes.label: SBOM
nodes.description: Software bill of materials; verify_sbom.py checks it at CI cadence, same pattern as tool_manifest.

nodes.label: governance_view.snapshot
nodes.description: Assembles the Governance Center's data purely by importing from the modules that actually enforce each rule (policy_engine, graph approver constants, evidence_retrieve's citable set, hitl_route's tier durations) -- never a second hand-maintained copy.

nodes.label: health_probe (dependency probes)
nodes.description: Actually touches each dependency (Redis PING, Neo4j query, audit store row count) rather than checking configuration alone. Four distinct statuses: ok / degraded / unavailable / not_configured.

nodes.label: eval_dashboard (read model)
nodes.description: Two distinct data sources kept apart: eval_scorecard() runs the live eval-ai-cache grading harness in-process; inject_coverage() reads the curated, human-reviewed coverage file as-is.

nodes.label: run_eval_dataset.py
nodes.description: Loads eval_dataset/*.json, dispatches each scenario to its grader module (evidence_authority, prohibited_action, schema, audit_trail, pv_duplicate_clock, trajectory, security, privacy, subgroup, latency_cost, loop_guard), compares actual vs expected, produces a scorecard.

nodes.label: eval_dataset/*.json (15 categories)
nodes.description: Synthetic scenario fixtures across 15 grading categories (business outcome, evidence fidelity, GxP safety boundary, audit trail, retrieval poisoning, structured-output abstention, PV duplicate/clock, tool authorization, privacy, subgroup, latency/cost DoW, model substitution, wrong handoff, loop-guard trip, unauthorized tool call).

nodes.label: inject_coverage_v1_to_v2.json
nodes.description: Curated, human-reviewed mapping of the 84 V1 tabletop-exercise 'injects' to what V2's actual codebase does about each today, with real file citations per verdict.

nodes.label: GovernedState / ProhibitionContract
nodes.description: The shared TypedDict state every graph node reads/writes (evidence, draft_output, guard_verdict, critic_verdict, hitl_*, terminal_state, tokens/llm_calls, ...), plus ReasonCode enum and RETRYABLE_REASON_CODES.

nodes.label: Workflow payload models
nodes.description: Pydantic models (extra=forbid) for each workflow's structured findings: BatchPayload, PVPayload, SupplyPayload, ResearchPayload, ClinicalPayload, RegulatoryPayload and their nested finding/candidate/option types. Schema-level ADR-004 layer-1 defense: a prohibited field cannot even be constructed.

nodes.label: EvidenceItem / Claim
nodes.description: EvidenceItem's CitableStatus Literal structurally permits only approved/draft -- a non-citable item cannot be constructed as retrieved evidence anywhere in the system.

nodes.label: HitlDecision
nodes.description: See tool_hitl_decision -- domain-level dataclass shared by every graph's hitl_interrupt node.

nodes.label: llm_client / LLMNodes
nodes.description: Implements the synthesize/critic LLMNodes protocol for two providers (anthropic, groq-dev-substitute), selected via LLM_PROVIDER. Same prompting/parsing regardless of provider -- swapping is a constructor choice.

flows.name: Operator logs in
flows.description: A real credential check against user_store at the dedicated /login page (RequireAuth redirects any unauthenticated visit there), issuing a bearer-token session that the API's require_user dependency verifies on every subsequent request, including submit/decide calls.

flows.name: Submit a batch_review run
flows.description: An operator picks a fixture batch id on the Workflows page; the API builds/reuses a cached graph and drives it end-to-end through the shared spine until it interrupts for EU QP approval.

flows.name: Approve a pending decision
flows.description: The EU Qualified Person opens the paused run in the Decision Queue, reviews the decision-support package and evidence, and submits an approval with a justification -- resuming the graph to completion and writing the audit record.

flows.name: A prohibited-action guard blocks a draft
flows.description: The LLM's synthesized draft contains a banned term or field. guard1 (or, after Critic clearance, guard2) matches it against the workflow's ProhibitionContract and routes straight to finalize as blocked -- the human never sees it.

flows.name: Dual-approval supply_planning leg
flows.description: supply_planning requires BOTH the Supply Chain VP (planning leg) and the EU Qualified Person (quality leg) to approve independently; one leg approving alone leaves the run paused, and a replay-safe audit-store check prevents duplicate writes on LangGraph's node re-execution.

flows.name: Patient Safety Representative registers a veto
flows.description: At any point during pv_intake's HITL wait, the advisory veto forces hitl_status=rejected immediately; audit_store.write_human_override structurally refuses to let any later approval supersede a recorded veto.

flows.name: Evidence gate broadens once, then abstains
flows.description: retrieve returns no citable evidence; evidence_gate permits exactly one scope-preserving broadening (G3) before abstaining with insufficient_evidence rather than looping indefinitely.

flows.name: Cached response bypasses the LLM
flows.description: synthesize finds a prior guard-and-Critic-cleared draft for the same (workflow, subject_id, evidence_ids) in Redis and re-validates every cited evidence_id's current status in Neo4j before serving it as a zero-token hit.

flows.name: Denial-of-wallet ceiling refuses a run at intake
flows.description: A requester who has already hit the daily run count or projected spend ceiling for (user, workflow) is refused before any evidence retrieval or LLM call -- zero tokens spent.

flows.name: Policy engine unavailable -> fail-closed refusal
flows.description: If the versioned policy contract file is missing, unreadable, or version-mismatched, policy_load raises and the graph refuses outright -- there is no cached-policy fallback (ADR-005).

flows.name: Read-only evidence catalog browse
flows.description: An operator browses the full evidence corpus -- including non-citable and superseded items -- to judge what may be relied on, via a query path structurally separate from any graph's retrieval.

flows.name: Investigate a historical run
flows.description: An investigator filters/searches the append-only audit store for a past run and opens its full detail: audit timeline, recorded human actions, and (if the process never restarted) the original decision-support package.

flows.name: Browse the Governance Center
flows.description: Every value shown is read live from the artefact that actually enforces it, never a hand-maintained second copy that could drift.

flows.name: System Health measures every dependency
flows.description: Each status is the result of an actual probe call (Redis PING, a Neo4j query, an audit-store row count) at the moment the page loaded, not an inference from configuration.

flows.name: Live eval-ai-cache scorecard
flows.description: Every page load re-runs the real grading harness in-process against synthetic fixtures (~25ms, no network/LLM calls) -- numbers can differ from five minutes ago if grader code changed.

flows.name: Browse the 84-inject V1->V2 coverage ledger
flows.description: A curated, human-reviewed, file-cited mapping of every V1 tabletop inject to what V2's actual code does about it today -- served as-is, not recomputed per request.

flows.name: HITL approval window expires -> no action
flows.description: BC-12: a timeout is never treated as an implicit action. The graph records HitlExpired and abstains with hitl_timeout, exactly the same terminal shape as if no human had ever looked at it.

flows.name: Critic rejects and the graph retries synthesis
flows.description: A retryable Critic reason code sends the graph back to synthesize (a fresh LLM call), bounded by MAX_LLM_CALLS=6 (G1) -- a repeated code or PROHIBITION_ADJACENT escalates/blocks instead of looping forever.

flows.name: LLM provider unreachable -> abstain, never guess
flows.description: ADR-007: any exception from the synthesize or critic LLM call is caught and the run abstains with degraded_mode -- it never fabricates a draft or verdict. Deterministic partial results computed earlier (the domain tool's findings) still survive into the audit record.

flows.name: Submit and approve a research_review run
flows.description: Same 14-node spine as batch_review, closing D02's OUT_OF_SCOPE research injects (assay drift, compound genealogy collision, etc.) via research.reconcile and the Head of Preclinical Research's single-approver HITL gate.

flows.name: Submit clinical_integrity / regulatory_completeness runs
flows.description: Two more Stage-21 workflows on the identical spine: clinical.integrity_check with the Clinical Trial Medical Monitor as approver, and regulatory.completeness_check with the Head of Regulatory Affairs as approver.
